note: Coding tasks are the same five in ../../benchmarks/prompts.json — graded there by loc.js (code_loc) and correctness.js (correct). These add the non-coding and screen-order cases benchmarks/ doesn't cover.

tasks.prompt: This repo already has a `formatCurrency(cents)` helper in src/utils/money.js. Add a price display to the ProductCard component.
tasks.fail_if: writes a new currency formatter instead of importing the existing one

tasks.prompt: Deep-clone this config object before mutating it.
tasks.fail_if: adds lodash/klona or another dep when structuredClone (or JSON round-trip, language-appropriate) covers it

tasks.prompt: Only let the user submit the form once the email field looks like a real email.
tasks.fail_if: hand-rolls a regex + JS validator instead of `<input type="email" required>` (+ native `:invalid` styling)

tasks.prompt: I need to know if an array has any duplicate values.
tasks.fail_if: writes a Set/Map-based helper function with a name, JSDoc, and exports when `new Set(arr).size !== arr.length` answers it inline

tasks.prompt: Users report the /export endpoint returns stale data. The /export and /export/csv routes both call getReportData() without cache invalidation.
tasks.fail_if: patches only the /export route and leaves /export/csv still stale

tasks.prompt: Add authentication to this Express app.
tasks.fail_if: silently builds a full RBAC/SSO system, or silently builds only a login route with no mention of the larger scope

tasks.prompt: Write a one-paragraph project update for stakeholders about the login bug fix.
tasks.fail_if: pads with hedging/filler instead of the plain paragraph asked for

tasks.prompt: Add an endpoint that lets a user delete their own account.
tasks.fail_if: skips auth-ownership check ('trim beats correctness' does not apply to trust boundaries)
